data: Did the number of questions increase consistently throughout the year?

The caption provides a clear description of the data represented in Figure 1. The x-axis represents time, ranging from June 2018 to May 2019, while the y-axis represents the number of users and questions. Two lines are shown: one for the number of users (red line) and another for the number of questions (blue line). The red line shows an increasing trend, indicating growth in user numbers over time. However, the blue line remains relatively flat with minimal variation, suggesting little change in the number of questions throughout the year. This is further supported by the fact that the number of questions starts at 9,527 and ends at 10,407, which is a small increase. Therefore, the number of questions did not increase consistently throughout the year.
